title: The Entertainers' owners and the birthday trumpet
summary: The club is run by two Sicilians; the band buys Lee his first trumpet for his birthday.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: So, this entertainer was run by two Sicilians, Johnny Latters and Joe Latters. Used to be named Old Hunt and One Ranch where Joe Oliver used to play. Yeah. And all the good boys in the good old days. Packed every night, packed every night. We'd close everything down in that part. So, I got tangled up. I can tell it now because it's a long time, it's been a long time. I got tangled up with all the awful friends, girl that time. My name was Albertine. And so, everybody was telling stories at that time about birthdays. That's how I'm coming to get off the corner at the trumpet. So, I said, like, I said, you know, one thing, Monday's my birthday. And this was in the, it wasn't nearby, the spring of the year. My birthday's in October. I said, this is my birthday. I'm getting a birthday. So, Manuel Moneta, saxophone plays away from Welleheim selling them mincebers, selling them bayonetbers. So, they want to know, the girl wants to know what to buy, the people left their friends. So Manuel Moneta say, you better get him a good cornet, a good trumpet. He said, get that short cornet out of his hand and get him a long trumpet. So, they went down and bought me an artist model bushel from the prettiest trumpet that I've seen in my life. And that was my birthday, slipped it in my chair, got me off to the bar to get a glass of gin and Big John to serve me some gin and say, when I come back, the band hit Happy Birthday and presented me this trumpet. And I put the cornet down and I've been playing, 24, 25. I started playing the trumpet.
